help.tagline: No Docs, No Code. — AI-Native Architecture Protocol

start.desc: Cold start a new project. Interview vision, tech stack, generate doc skeleton.
start.detail: Output: Vision + Tech Stack + Roadmap + Global doc skeleton
start.example: e.g. /archi.start I want to build a Todo CLI tool in Rust

inherit.desc: Take over a legacy project. Full code scan, reverse-engineer architecture, fill docs.
inherit.detail: For existing codebases lacking Architext documentation

scope.desc: Requirement decomposition. Read Scope Brief, break large requirements into Roadmap tasks with dependencies.
scope.detail: Output: Multiple Roadmap tasks (with ID/goal/deps). Falls back to interview mode without Brief

plan.desc: Deep task planning. Architecture interview for existing Roadmap tasks, generate full docs.
plan.detail: Output: Spec (logic) + UI (visual, if applicable) + Plan (steps)
plan.example1: e.g. /archi.plan INF-001 needs OAuth login support

code.desc: Translate docs to code. Read Plan, implement step by step with checks & audit.
code.detail: Prerequisite: Task must have complete Spec + Plan

audit.desc: Independent deep code audit. Find bugs, gaps, and compliance issues.
audit.detail: With ID: audit specific task's code | No ID: project-level health check

fix.desc: Fix a bug (not a requirement change). Diagnose and fix code, usually no Spec change.
fix.detail: Auto-records fix process to Plan for documentation consistency

edit.desc: Local requirement change. Update Spec/UI docs first, then sync code changes.
edit.detail: Change chain: Update Spec/UI --> Append Plan steps --> Modify code

revise.desc: Global change (tech stack, architecture). Analyzes impact, cascades updates to affected Tasks after confirmation.
revise.detail: Scope: Vision / Tech Stack / Roadmap / Related Task docs
revise.example: e.g. /archi.revise migrate from REST to GraphQL

map.desc: Refresh architecture map. Rescan directory tree, update map.json.
map.detail: Use when directory structure changes to keep map.json in sync

remove.desc: Decommission a task. Full cleanup: impact analysis → delete docs+code → purge global refs.
remove.detail: Scope: Task docs / business code / roadmap / map / context_glue

help.desc: Project navigator & contextual Q&A. Analyze state, suggest next actions.
help.detail: No args: smart next-step recommendation; with question: project-aware answer
help.example2: e.g. /archi.help what does the data model look like?

init.desc: Initialize Architext framework. Generate rules, doc directory, prompt templates, Project Brief.
init.editor: Target IDE (cursor / trae / windsurf / vscode / claude / opencode)
init.type: Project type (web / fullstack / api / cli / lib / mobile / miniapp / desktop / web-desktop / extension / realtime / ai-agent / hybrid)

update.desc: Sync latest rule templates to project, keep rules aligned with framework version.
update.dry_run: Preview changes only, no actual writes

doctor.desc: Read-only health scan: config validity, directory integrity, global file schemas, IDE rule files.

task.desc: Manage Roadmap tasks. View progress, update status, check dependency consistency.
task.detail: No args: list all tasks | --check: verify dependency consistency
task.example: e.g. npx archi task INF-001 --status done

plan.desc: Check Task Plan completion (auto-detects manual verification sections).

render.desc: Render JSON data files (roadmap/plan) into human-readable Markdown views.

template.desc: Fetch template files to project root for filling.

uninstall.desc: Remove Architext framework and all generated files (rules, docs, config).
